summary: Reproduced the multimodal EAGLE3 draft-extend mRoPE cardinality defect on the prepared base: 10 requests with four extended tokens each produced 10 position columns for 40 query rows. The fallback now creates one consecutive, delta-shifted mRoPE position per extended token. Added a failing-before/passing-after regression with batched, ragged, single-token, and unaffected in-prompt boundary coverage. Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/34154 is open with the same core correction but is not present in this base.

tests.what_was_measured: Untouched-base reproduction: mrope_positions had shape [3, 10] while the forward batch contained 40 tokens; retained in reports/j-dde29a0d6b3d/raw/repro_before.log.
Regression failed before the fix in the batched cardinality, ragged cardinality/value, and single-token position cases; the in-range prompt slice boundary passed.
All four CPU regression and boundary tests passed after the fix.

On the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), the generated [3, 7] GPU position tensor exactly matched an independently constructed CPU arithmetic reference for two requests with different deltas and extend lengths.
Repository formatting, lint, spelling, and registered-test validation passed for the changed files.

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-dde29a0d6b3d/raw/gpu_inventory.log and gpu_positions_after.log record one AMD Instinct MI355X, capability (9, 5), and exact GPU/CPU-reference equality.

remaining_limitations: The Qwen3-VL target and EAGLE3 draft checkpoint weights were not available locally, so the full HTTP serving crash and fused/native rotary execution were not reproduced end to end. The deterministic fixture is Llama-only and cannot qualify this Qwen3-VL architecture, so it was not substituted. This change is Python-only and requires no native rebuild.
